result.topic_en: Riemann treats the second case of the rotating fluid ellipsoid, in which two of the quantity pairs u,u'; v,v'; w,w' vanish, reducing the equations to two relations for w and w'; he then studies the case where the shape (a,b,c) is constant, with trial computations of integrals and logarithmic expansions in a small parameter α; some upside-down inequality calculations appear at the right.

methods.what: Reduction of the equations of motion when u,u',v,v' vanish (rotation about one axis) to two equations for w,w'
Energy-type expression for the steady (constant-shape) case including gravitational potential integral
Equilibrium condition in the case a=c
Substitution a=α^2, b=1/α^4 and closed-form evaluation of the integral as a logarithm
Series expansion in small α of the logarithmic term and of the energy expression, then its derivative in α

items.english: We now still have to investigate the case when two of the quantity pairs u,u'; v,v'; w,w' are permanently zero.

items.quote: ein Fall, der die [-Lehre-] von Dirichlet untersuchten [-Fälle-], so wie den {+beiden+} [-?-] {+Jacobi'schen+} Fall [?] und den Dedekind'schen [?] gefundenen als speciellen Fall umfasst.
items.english: A case which includes as special cases those investigated by Dirichlet, as well as the Jacobi case and the one found by Dedekind.

items.quote: und zuerst den Fall untersuchen, in welchem $a, b, c$ constant [-bleiben-] {+sind+} und also die flüssige Masse ihre Gestalt nicht ändert.
items.english: and first investigate the case in which a, b, c are constant and thus the fluid mass does not change its shape.
